correctness.rationale: The Henson extension property reduces adjacency of new realizations to disjoint independent old-neighbor sets. The exact degree is a product of Fibonacci path independent-set counts over the cyclic gaps of the fixed independent set. The three exchange identities with nonnegative Fibonacci factors give both sharp extrema and exclusive equality configurations for all n,k. A labeled cycle/start-gap double count gives exact multiplicities. Complete direct cycle enumeration through n=16 verified every extremum and count.

value.rationale: The invariant counts the distinct complete one-types compatible by a new adjacency with a fixed k-neighbor type, a natural refinement of two-point extension counting. Exact classification of the entire rankwise extrema, their realized gap patterns, and multiplicities at every n,k is a structural statement; it detects the sharp first degree heterogeneity at n=2k+2. Its full rankwise conclusions are neither mere instance substitutions nor known aggregate-count tables.
